0022600240.text: The Boston Celtics (10-2, 1st in the East and the Atlantic) come into this 13th game of their season on a five-game winning streak, going 5-0 at home and 9-1 over their last ten. The Dallas Mavericks (7-4, 8th in the West) have won three straight, but Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation) are all out, while Boston's Paul George is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Celtics won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 120-100 win in Boston on March 6, 2026.
